This is a little something that's on my mind at the moment, I don't know why, so I am going to share it.

So, this happened like 5 or 6 years ago, I was chilling at my friend's house and his cousin (the girl) was visiting him. Now at the time, I really liked the chick man. She sometimes hung out with my friend and I, but we never had any true conversations you know, but I knew she liked me too, cause she was staring at me and laughing at my shitty jokes and shit.

Anyway, so there I was. She was alone watching TV. I thought "fuck it, I'm going to make my move and if I get rejected, I'm not gonna let it bother me."
I went and sat next to her, we had some small talk about something that wasn't important. I think she got bored and when the adverts came on, she went outside.

"Fuck, fuck, fuck. I have my chance now. Can't fucking blow this by being slow."

I decided to wait until the show started again to call her. (She was watching Days of our Lives). So, when the show started, I called her and she came. "Fuck yes."

So, she came and I was sitting there nervous as fuck, didn't know how to go through with my plan. So of course, I decided the best action would be to pull the "fake yawn" move.
It worked.

So, I was sitting with my arm over her neck like a boss and it felt great, but I wasn't finished yet.

I decided to pull her head closer, she felt the force and sorta like, left the force of my hand behind and came towards me by herself.

Because it was my first time, I went really fast. She told me to slow down, and I felt a little awkward, but at least I made it. Felt awesome afterwards.

But now that I think of it, I kind of cringe. The yawn move, me not knowing jack. etc. But, I guess you have to learn one way or another, right?

"Why am I telling you this? I don't know."
- 10th grade maths teacher.
